scope: Farm memory release notice, previous Farm memory descriptions and current guide stops in four languages. No fluent review claimed. Original farmer observations, crop/bed names and archived release sources remain unchanged.
tourDecision: The new entry retains the existing Farm memory tour destinations and descriptions explicitly, so an intervening map release cannot push its guide outside the visible five-note window.

entries.source: Photo dates are easier to read; scroll through older notes on desktop.

drafts.zu: Izinsuku zezithombe sezifundeka kalula; skrola kumanothi amadala kukhompyutha.
drafts.st: Matsatsi a dinepe a se a baleha habonolo; tsamaisetsa dintlheng tsa kgale khomphutheng.
drafts.ts: Masiku ya swifaniso sweswi swa olova ku ma hlaya; skrola eka tinotsi ta khale eka khompyuta.
drafts.ve: Maḓuvha a zwifanyiso zwino a a vhalea nga hu leluwaho; skrolani kha notsi dza kale kha khomphyutha.

entries.source: Photo dates and journal headings are easier to read.

drafts.zu: Izinsuku zezithombe nezihloko zejenali sezifundeka kalula.
drafts.st: Matsatsi a dinepe le dihlooho tsa jenale di se di baleha habonolo.
drafts.ts: Masiku ya swifaniso ni tinhlokomhaka ta jenali sweswi swa olova ku swi hlaya.
drafts.ve: Maḓuvha a zwifanyiso na ṱhoho dza dzhenala zwino zwi a vhalea nga hu leluwaho.

entries.source: Farm memory search, photos and saved copies now support isiZulu.

drafts.zu: Ukusesha, izithombe namakhophi agciniwe Ezinkumbulo zepulazi manje kusekela isiZulu.
drafts.st: Patlo, dinepe le dikopi tse bolokilweng tsa dikgopotso tsa polasi jwale di tshehetsa isiZulu.
drafts.ts: Ku lavisisa, swifaniso ni tikopi leti hlayisiweke ta switsundzuxo swa purasi sweswi swi seketela isiZulu.
drafts.ve: U ṱoḓa, zwifanyiso na khophi dzo vhulungwaho dza khumbudzo dza bulasi zwino zwi tikedza isiZulu.

entries.source: Tap a crop or bed on a note to see its journal history.

drafts.zu: Thepha isitshalo noma umbhede kunothi ukuze ubone umlando wako kujenali.
drafts.st: Tobetsa sejalo kapa bethe ya temo ntlheng e ngotsweng ho bona nalane ya yona jenaleng.
drafts.ts: Khoma ximilana kumbe mubedo eka notsi ku vona matimu ya xona eka jenali.
drafts.ve: Kwatamani tshimela kana mubethe kha notsi uri ni vhone ḓivhazwakale yatsho kha dzhenala.

entries.source: Choose a smaller printable copy with notes only.

drafts.zu: Khetha ikhophi encane ongayiphrinta enamanothi kuphela.
drafts.st: Kgetha kopi e nyane e ka hatiswang e nang le dintlha tse ngotsweng feela.
drafts.ts: Hlawula kopi leyitsongo leyi nga kandziyisiwaka leyi nga ni tinotsi ntsena.
drafts.ve: Khethani khophi ṱhukhu ine ya nga gandiswa i re na notsi fhedzi.

entries.source: Open a field note from a task, with its crop and bed ready to check.

drafts.zu: Vula inothi lasensimini emsebenzini, nesitshalo nombhede walo kulungele ukuhlolwa.
drafts.st: Bula ntlha e ngotsweng ya tshimo ho tswa mosebetsing, sejalo le bethe ya temo di loketse ho hlahlojwa.
drafts.ts: Pfula notsi ya nsimu eka ntiro, ximilana ni mubedo wa kona swi lunghekele ku kamberiwa.
drafts.ve: Vulani notsi ya tsimuni kha mushumo, tshimela na mubethe zwo lugela u sedzuluswa.

entries.source: Find journal notes by crop, bed, date or words you remember.

drafts.zu: Thola amanothi ejenali ngesitshalo, ngombhede, ngosuku noma ngamagama owakhumbulayo.
drafts.st: Fumana dintlha tsa jenale ka sejalo, bethe ya temo, letsatsi kapa mantswe ao o a hopolang.
drafts.ts: Kuma tinotsi ta jenali hi ximilana, mubedo, siku kumbe marito lawa u ma tsundzukaka.
drafts.ve: Wanani notsi dza dzhenala nga tshimela, mubethe, ḓuvha kana maipfi ane na a humbula.

entries.source: Compare dated photos and download selected notes for an adviser.

drafts.zu: Qhathanisa izithombe ezinezinsuku bese ulanda amanothi akhethiwe omeluleki.
drafts.st: Bapisa dinepe tse nang le matsatsi mme o jarolle dintlha tse kgethilweng bakeng sa moeletsi.
drafts.ts: Pimanisa swifaniso leswi nga ni masiku kutani u kopa tinotsi leti hlawuriweke ta mutsundzuxi.
drafts.ve: Vhambedzani zwifanyiso zwi re na maḓuvha ni kone u dzhenisa notsi dzo khethiwaho dza mueletshedzi.

entries.source: Harvest tasks open the crop and blank quantity field, ready to fill in.

drafts.zu: Imisebenzi yokuvuna ivula isitshalo nendawo yenani engenalutho, elungele ukugcwaliswa.
drafts.st: Mesebetsi ya kotulo e bula sejalo le sebaka se se nang letho sa bongata, se loketse ho tlatswa.
drafts.ts: Mintirho ya ntshovelo yi pfula ximilana ni ndhawu leyi nga riki na nhlayo, yi lunghekele ku tatiwa.
drafts.ve: Mishumo ya khaṋo i vula tshimela na fhethu ha tshivhalo hu si na tshithu, ho lugela u ḓadzwa.

drafts.ts: Kambela switsundzuxo swa purasi ra wena

drafts.st: Batla dintlha tsa hao, bapisa dinepe tse bolokilweng mme o boloke kopi e ka hatiswang.
drafts.ts: Lavisisa tinotsi ta wena, pimanisa swifaniso leswi hlayisiweke kutani u hlayisa kopi leyi nga kandziyisiwaka.
drafts.ve: Ṱoḓani notsi dzaṋu, vhambedzani zwifanyiso zwo vhulungwaho ni kone u vhulunga khophi ine ya nga gandiswa.

drafts.zu: Vula uhlaka lwenothi lasensimini noma urekhode isivuno sangempela emsebenzini wesitshalo.
drafts.st: Bula moralo wa ntlha ya tshimo kapa o rekote kotulo ya nnete ho tswa mosebetsing wa sejalo.
drafts.ts: Pfula mpfapfarhuto wa notsi ya nsimu kumbe u rhekhoda ntshovelo wa xiviri eka ntiro wa ximilana.
drafts.ve: Vulani mvetamveto ya notsi ya tsimuni kana ni rekhode khaṋo ya vhukuma kha mushumo wa tshimela.
